name: Memphis-Style BBQ Ribs
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Place chunks in smoker or charcoal grill set for indirect heat at 250°F (120°C).
Combine liquid ingredients and bring to a boil over high heat.
Place spareribs into smoker or grill for 4–5 hours, basting occasionally with sauce.
Brush remaining sauce on top of ribs and place on a medium-high grill until browned. The internal temperature of the ribs before removing from the grill needs to be at least 145°F (63°C).
Let rest for 10 minutes, covered, and carve.
